topic: Example reference for the result adjunct in §12 [1]
claim: “In [ii] the airline’s overbooking is treated as subordinate and expressed within an adjunct of cause (more specifically, of reason), whereas in [ii] it is the other situation, our not being able to get on the plane, that is expressed as a subordinate clause, this time within an adjunct of result.”
evidence_summary: [1ii] (p. 725) is the reason example. [1iii] is the result example: The airline had overbooked, so that two of us couldn’t get on the plane, labelled “[result]”.
proposed_wording: whereas in [iii] it is the other situation
inference: Does the second reference point to the result example?

evidence.passage: §12, p. 726. “whereas in [ii] it is the other situation, our not being able to get on the plane”
